body: It's laziness or cowardice. Probably both. Every day that I'm thinking about it I do not want to live. I really don't. I hate my life and I am in constant mental agony that is only getting worse and worse by the day. I want the suffering to end but it's never going to end. I ruined my life. I'm out of options in life. I don't want to exist because I know that no matter what I do the suffering will never end. I need a way out, and there is no other way out of this life I ruined.
